title: Bound the Legacy candidate parity-audit query
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Make the remaining Legacy historical Paper FAK candidate query complete within its existing timeout by making its parity-audit exclusions bounded and indexable without changing candidate membership or order.
inScope: Change only GetHistoricalPaperFakFeeBackfillCandidatesAsync and its focused tests.
Replace the combined multi-source historical_gross_net_parity_audit OR predicate with source-specific bounded checks over the already materialized strategy candidate keys.
Preserve exclusions for PaperSellFill, PaperRun including legacy old-payload binding, PaperPosition, and PaperSettlement accounting decisions.

Preserve the existing 10-second command timeout, strategy/source/status/cutoff/cursor filters, fallback and terminal-run guards, chronological ordering, page limit, returned payload, and read-only candidate behavior.
Run focused tests, a solution build, requirement validation, independent semantic review, task-only commits, and push.
outOfScope: No strategy, signal, order, fill, settlement, PnL, ROI, fee, execution, Paper, or Live behavior changes.
No database schema, index, migration, data, configuration, timeout, worker scheduling, retry policy, or service startup changes.
No Production writes, deployment, service stop, service restart, or log cleanup.
No changes to the already deployed Paper settlement deadlock handling or to other Legacy backfill phases and queries.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact Legacy Paper FAK candidate selection for one strategy visit; immutable runtime cutoff and optional cursor remain caller-supplied and unchanged.
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the exact deployed failure and current SQL, then verify read-only that rank-2 strategy b7c50005-0001-4000-8166-000000000003 has only two LegacyUnknown fills before cutoff 2026-08-07T22:44:55.219515Z and that the timeout occurs after the strategy-first fill probe in the combined parity-audit exclusion.

requirements.text: Доработать только parity-audit exclusion внутри GetHistoricalPaperFakFeeBackfillCandidatesAsync так, чтобы проверка была bounded/indexable и сохраняла точный результат существующего запроса.
acceptanceCriteria: The candidate query first materializes the exact strategy's eligible LegacyUnknown fill keys and evaluates each parity source shape against that bounded set instead of using one correlated multi-source OR over the audit table.

PaperSellFill decisions are matched by exact fill source_id; PaperRun decisions are matched by exact run source_id or the legacy old_payload_json paper_order_id binding; PaperPosition and PaperSettlement decisions are matched by the existing evidence paperFillIds binding.
A candidate excluded by any one of the four existing parity decision shapes remains excluded, and an otherwise eligible candidate with no matching parity decision remains included.

The existing strategy/source/status/cutoff/cursor filters, fallback and terminal-run exclusions, chronological tuple ordering, fetch limit, returned records, 10-second command timeout, and read-only behavior are unchanged.
No schema, index, migration, configuration, worker, settlement, strategy, Paper execution, or Live execution behavior changes are present in the diff.

verification.expected: All focused source-contract and PostgreSQL integration tests pass, including exact inclusion/exclusion coverage for every retained parity binding shape and unchanged tuple paging.
The full solution test suite passes apart from explicitly documented environment skips unrelated to this request.
Release build succeeds with zero errors.

verification.command: Run an exact BEGIN READ ONLY, SET LOCAL statement_timeout='15s' Production EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) for rank-2 strategy b7c50005-0001-4000-8166-000000000003 and cutoff 2026-08-07T22:44:55.219515Z when direct server access is available.

If Production access remains unavailable, record that blocker and do not claim Production runtime verification.

verification.command: Independent reviewer compares the verbatim request and approved semantic digest against the actual task diff and verification evidence.
verification.expected: Reviewer reports no scope drift, semantic regression, or unsupported completion claim.
